大壮挠着头，脸上流露出一抹尴尬道：“我要是能跟山哥一样准，那就厉害了。”

“第一次射箭，能射得出去就不错了。”

“等这次狩猎回家休整的时候，你们三个要是闲的没事，就去取弓找个地方练习练习，咱们虽然没那么多钱喂子弹，但是弓练的准了，以后枪也就打的准了。”

“实在不行，就找个弹弓练习练习。”

李青山接过猎弓，去前面将插在地上的箭拔了出来，检查一下箭锋后，便将其重新装回了箭袋之内。

“嗯！”

大壮，二壮和赵红旗三人郑重点了点头。

一上午的时间很快过去。

今天上午没有狩猎到大型的野物，全部都是野鸡，野兔，还有一只两只黄鼬，也就是黄鼠狼，这东西是东北的保家仙，老猎人或者老人看到了，肯定不会让打的。

但是，作为新时代青年。

李青山避它锋芒？

两箭过去，两块钱直接到手。

这东西的肉不值钱，这要是皮毛值钱，这东西皮毛分为好几个档次，现在是因为夏天，档次肯定不会太高，但是身上没有伤口，八毛一块都有可能。

而且这两只，倒也不是十分肥硕。

要是冬天的黄鼬，长得还肥的话，一张皮能卖到两块多钱，这可是一笔不小的收获。

前世，李青山与人闲聊，有个岭南地区的在这个年代狩到两只黄鼬，也就是黄鼠狼子，皮毛卖了后换了一家子半个月的口粮。

除此之外，野鸡狩到四只，野兔狩到五只！

还算是收获极为不错的。

“山哥，现在时间还早，咱们要不要继续走一走？”大壮身上挂着野鸡和野兔，擦着额头上的汗珠道。

“打猎不能急于一时！”

“咱们四点多出来，现在都八点了，回去休息休息吧！”

“主要精力放在下午！”

李青山开口道。

“嗯！”

大壮三人点了点头，朝着趟子房赶。

Da Zhuang scratched his head and said with a hint of embarrassment on his face: "If I could be as accurate as Brother Shan, that would be great."

"It's your first time shooting an arrow. It's good if you can shoot it."

"When you return home from this hunting trip and rest, if the three of you have nothing to do, go get your bows and find a place to practice. Although we don't have that much money to feed bullets, if you practice the bow accurately, you will be able to shoot the gun accurately in the future."

"If it doesn't work, just find a slingshot and practice."

Li Qingshan took the hunting bow, went to the front and pulled out the arrow stuck on the ground. After checking the arrow edge, he put it back into the quiver.

"Yeah!"

Da Zhuang, Er Zhuang and Zhao Hongqi nodded solemnly.

The morning passed quickly.

No large wild animals were hunted this morning. They were all pheasants, hares, and one or two weasels, also known as weasels. These are Baojiaxian from the Northeast. If an old hunter or old man sees them, he will definitely not let them hunt them.

However, as a young person in the new era.

Li Qingshan avoids its edge?

Two arrows passed and two dollars were obtained directly.

The meat of this thing is not valuable, but if the fur is valuable, the fur of this thing is divided into several grades. It is summer now, so the grade will definitely not be too high, but there is no wound on the body, and it is possible to get it for eight cents.

And these two are not very fat.

If the winter weasel is still fat, a skin can be sold for more than two yuan, which is a big gain.

In his previous life, Li Qingshan was chatting with someone. There was a man from the Lingnan area who hunted two yellow weasels, also known as weasels, in this era. After selling the furs, they bought half a month's rations for the family.

In addition, four pheasants and five hares were hunted!

The harvest is pretty good.

"Brother Shan, it's still early, should we continue walking?" Da Zhuang said, wiping the sweat from his forehead with a pheasant and hare hanging on his body.

"Hunting can't be rushed!"

"We came out after four o'clock. It's already eight o'clock now. Let's go back and rest!"

“The main focus is in the afternoon!”

Li Qingshan said.

"Yeah!"

The three big and strong men nodded and rushed towards the house.
